title: The Lakeview Cabin
description:
The Lakeview Cabin is a luxury cabin that sleeps 2 people with a king-size bed and a couch. Fully equipped kitchen, spacious living room, and a private outdoor area. This cabin is pet-friendly!.
A luxurious retreat just across the street from Old Hickory Lake. There is an access area where you can launch your boat, kayak, swim, hike, and picnic. The charming cabin features a wraparound deck and a fire pit, offering the perfect blend of comfort for a relaxing getaway.
